**Review: search ad, Pebblebrook Tea Co.**

**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" | Allowlisted: tea bags are plastic-free (EN 13432 supplier certificate) |
| "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" | Allowlisted, exact wording |
| "Founded in Bristol in 2019" | Allowlisted (Companies House) |

**Other checks**
- **Superlatives, guarantees, urgency, testimonials, invented numbers:** none.
- **Health claims:** none.
- **Environmental claims:** only the two in section 2, with the exact approved wording. No general "eco-friendly" or "sustainable".
- **Banned words and structure:** none. No exclamation points, rhetorical-question opener, em-dash asides or abstract-noun triads. The voice is plain and fits the brand.
- **Disclosure:** this is a paid ad from the brand's own account, so the platform marks it and no extra label is needed.
- **Spelling:** nothing UK-specific is at issue.
- **Length:** the headline is 21 characters and the description is 79. You gave no limits, but both fit standard search ad limits (30 and 90).

**Before it goes live**
- Make sure the landing page also says the tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Every claim in an ad has to appear on the page it links to.
- Sam (marketing lead) needs to approve it, as with all public content.

Neither of these requires changing the copy, so nothing blocks publication.
